title: Stock Market Today Live, November 25: Sensex jumps 1,400 pts, Nifty crosses 25,750 snapping two-day losing streak; Banks, IT lead recovery - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 25th November 2026.

The Sensex, which had closed at 82,435.99 on Monday, opened at 83,436.89 and was trading at 83,822.74, up 1,386.75 points or 1.68 per cent, by 9.20 AM. The Nifty 50, which had settled at 25,349.65, opened at 25,658.35 and climbed to 25,737.45, gaining 387.80 points or 1.53 per cent at the same time. The recovery follows a holiday on Tuesday, with markets catching up to positive global cues.

Wednesday’s rebound is being driven in part by continued foreign institutional investor buying. FIIs have been net buyers in the cash market for 16 consecutive sessions. For the month so far, FII inflows have reached a record $13.2 billion according to NSDL data.

Globally, the picture remains unsettled. Asian markets were trading in the red, with the Nikkei 225 down over 2 per cent and the KOSPI falling more than 5 per cent, weighed down by a renewed sell-off in AI-linked stocks. On Wall Street, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 0.5 per cent and 1.5 per cent respectively on Tuesday, while the Dow Jones gained 0.9 per cent. Nvidia, which had staged a sharp rally, reversed course again.

India’s market opens sharply higher after a Monday sell-off, led by banks and IT, with FIIs driving a cautious rebound amid mixed global cues.

Exhicon Events Media Solutions Limited, India’s leading 360-degree exhibitions, events, and hospitality conglomerate, today announced the elevation of Simon Dennis to CEO – Luxury Sports

Nifty (Dec) futures is likely to rise to 26,100

Vishnu Chemicals stock rose 1% to Rs 507.10 on the NSE. Its subsidiary Vishnu Barium expands solar power capacity by 4.19 MW, taking total capacity to 8.49 MW

Crude oil futures traded lower on Wednesday morning despite reports of attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, as an industry report indicating an increase in US crude oil inventories weighed on prices. At 9.37 am on Wednesday, January Brent oil futures were at $90.12, down by 1.40 per cent, and January crude oil futures on WTI (West Texas Intermediate) were at $80.73, down by 1.61 per cent. December crude oil futures were trading at ₹7505 on Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) during the initial hour of trading on Wednesday against the previous close of ₹7581, down by 1 per cent, and January futures were trading at ₹7452 against the previous close of ₹7509, down by 0.76 per cent.

Adani Enterprises traded at Rs 2,730.10 on the NSE, up 2%. Company raised an additional Rs 2,790 cr from 360 ONE Alternates for Adani Airport Holdings. 360 ONE acquired a 1.55% stake in Adani Airports

ABB India to acquire Ziehl-Abegg, expanding offering for HVAC and industrial cooling applications

Jupiter Wagons rallied over 7% to Rs 198.87 on the NSE, following a joint venture with Woojin Industrial Systems Co., Ltd. (Woojin) of the Republic of Korea.

Aster DM as appointed Mr. Saurabh Anand Bhandari as Senior Management

Personnel designated as Vice President – Investor Relations, with effect from 23 November 2026. Consequent to said appointment, Mr. Sunil Kumar M R, Group Chief Financial Officer of the Company shall discontinue his additional role as an Interim Head - Investor Relations with effect from 23 November 2026.

Mr. Sunil Kumar M R continues as Group Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company.

Archean Chemical Industries: Rajesh Nair has been appointed as Chief Executive Officer of SiCSem Private Limited (“SiCSem”), a step-down subsidiary of the Company, with effect from November 09, 2026.

Lemon Tree Hotels Limited, one of India’s leading hospitality companies, has announced the signing of Lemon Tree Hotel, Kompally. The hotel will be managed by Carnation Hotels Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels Limited

Rashi Peripherals executed the Share Purchase Agreement and Shareholders Agreement between Rashi Peripherals Limited, Restar Corporation, Japan and Rashi Semiconductor Solutions Private Limited (“RSSPL”) for secondary sale of 26% shareholding of RSSPL by the Company.

Cipla announced the U.S. FDA approval and launch of Fluticasone HFA MDI, the first generic equivalent Flovent® HFA, in110 mcg and 220 mcg strengths, approved under an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA).

Highway Infrastructure has received a Work Order from Sacham Highway Real Estates Private Limited for development and construction of residential project - Highway Aerocity by Sacham Highway Real Estate Private Limited. The total value of the Work Order is approximately ₹12.00 crore.

Top gainers of Nifty 50: Infosys (+3.40%), HDFC Bank (+3.31%), Bajaj Finance (+3.03%), IndiGo (+2.61%), Axis Bank (+2.42%)

Top losers: Max Health (-1.75%), Hindalco (-1.57%), Titan (-1.19%), Tata Steel (-0.99%)

Sensex rallied 1410.75 pts or 1.71% to 83,846.74 by 9.16 am after higher opening at 83,436.89 compared to 82,435.99 previous close. Nifty 50 gained 385.95 pts or 1.52% to 25,735.60.

Gold prices extended their recovery from recent 14-month lows, supported by bargain hunting and improved investor sentiment following Nvidia’s reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, which initially revived optimism around AI investments and triggered a broad market rebound. However, the recovery remains fragile, with bullion facing pressure from expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening and uncertainty surrounding inflation.

The latest U.S. consumer confidence index surged to 103.3 in November, its highest level in nearly two years, supported by improving labour-market optimism and easing inflation expectations. Stronger consumer sentiment could reinforce concerns about economic resilience and limit expectations of monetary easing.
